partner_result_applied.application: Applied its single-square L^{3/2} theorem to U=D X^2, obtaining ||p_U||_{3/2}<=2D^{-1/3}, then interpolated to L^{6/5} inside the HLS branch of the full binary-indefinite L^3 proof.

proved_claims: For every independent density<=1 pair and every affine indefinite binary quadratic with D=a^2-alpha beta>0, ||p||_3<=C_bin D^{-1/3} for a universal finite C_bin.
An uncoupled third square yields ||p||_infinity<=2 C_bin (D|d|)^{-1/3}; this convolution branch is continuous.
If a fully coupled original-coordinate scalar pivot d has an indefinite 2x2 Schur complement S, then ||p_Q||_infinity<=4 C_bin^{3/4} (|d||det B|)^{-1/4}.
For inertia (2,1)/(1,2), the preceding theorem pays the majority-sign nonzero pivot branch; account04/B18 pays the minority-sign definite-Schur branch.
unresolved_implication: QFORM-MIXED-LEVERAGE-AGGREGATION: obtain a dimension-free global aggregation from the spectral three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis, combining diffuse cross-block smoothing with localized pivot/Schur estimates without selecting a single dimension-losing principal minor.
continuity_status: Continuous density proved for the uncoupled hyperbolic-plus-square branch; only essentially bounded density proved for the fully coupled dependent-smoothing branch.
